title: The Gift of Everything

i.c: The Gift of
Everything

title: The best traps are the ones we build for ourselves. The best lies are only true up close. When our faces are so pressed to the grindstone we don’t even think to look up anymore. That’s when the lies sink deepest.

i.c: The best traps are the ones we build for ourselves. The best lies are only true up close. When our faces are so pressed to the grindstone we don’t even think to look up anymore. That’s when the lies sink deepest.

title: We have allowed a prison to be built around us and we have placed the bricks ourselves.

i.c: We have allowed a prison to be built around us and we have placed the bricks ourselves.

title: People are not happy when they commute two hours each way, in a car they don’t own, to do a job they don’t like, for a company they
know
i
makes the world worse for their children.

i.c: People are not happy when they commute two hours each way, in a car they don’t own, to do a job they don’t like, for a company they
know
makes the world worse for their children.

title: People are not happy when the technology that should have brought them salvation from that fate was instead turned against them as a tool to enslave their minds, numb their senses, and turn their hearts against one another in ever finer, ever more pointless distinctions between us. We have allowed this machine to turn our differences into danger and our neighbors into strangers.

i.c: People are not happy when the technology that should have brought them salvation from that fate was instead turned against them as a tool to enslave their minds, numb their senses, and turn their hearts against one another in ever finer, ever more pointless distinctions between us. We have allowed this machine to turn our differences into danger and our neighbors into strangers.

title: People are not happy when their only value is a value that can be measured. When everything must have a point and that point must be known before you can even attempt the business of living. That is not living.

i.c: People are not happy when their only value is a value that can be measured. When everything must have a point and that point must be known before you can even attempt the business of living. That is not living.

title: People are not happy when they’re told that everything is figured out and the mysteries of our magical existence have been reduced, quantified, and accounted for. Nothing to see here. When our intellectual leaders taught us that dreams, imagination, feelings, and hope itself are not the real, powerful, constructive forces they really are, but neutered things to be cast aside as childish fancy.

i.c: People are not happy when they’re told that everything is figured out and the mysteries of our magical existence have been reduced, quantified, and accounted for. Nothing to see here. title: As if children were the ones in the wrong.

i.c: As if children were the ones in the wrong.

title: But people are not stupid.

i.c: But people are not stupid.

title: We know there’s something more. Something better. You can feel it. People want something they don’t know how to ask for.

i.c: We know there’s something more. Something better. You can feel it. People want something they don’t know how to ask for.

title: Well I do.

i.c: Well I do.

title: Resist the urge to find a good reason this feeling is not true. The answer is not in another job. It’s not in a business. It’s not working harder. There is no way to get ahead when we’re all sinking. The machine hides behind individual good reasons. Your sense that this structure is a siphon is not wrong.

title: You may be in a cage, but you don’t have to pretend to like it.

i.c: You may be in a cage, but you don’t have to pretend to like it.

title: Resist the urge to put your head back down simply because there are others who have it worse than you.

i.c: Resist the urge to put your head back down simply because there are others who have it worse than you.

title: Resist the urge to sit down again because you don’t want to complain.

i.c: Resist the urge to sit down again because you don’t want to complain.

title: Resist the urge to pretend the feelings of anxiety, pointlessness, and dread that seep in are anything like how life is supposed to be.

title: We were never meant to live this way.

i.c: We were never meant to live this way.

title: The good news… the good news is that we don’t have to. We can dismantle the machine that kept us small. It starts by accepting that is real, and we have constructed it.
